objective: Closed-Loop 4-Stage Actor-Critic UI/UX Pipeline with Unrolled Discovery (Forensic Analyst <-> Brand/Style Planner max 1 hop -> Clean ReAct Worker <-> Double-Pass 3-Axis Read-Only Judge) and <= 5 Active Rules per Node
acceptance_criteria: Stage 0 (ui-analyst): Headless-safe CoT-0 Intent-First probe, tokens/shadows/warning/menu-char/canvas inventory, DevTools/REA telemetry, AppSec secrets/omissions, AI Slop score, and causal Friction X -> Impact Y CLAREZA report

Stage 1 (ui-planner): Order-dependent ToT (post-analysis DESIGN.md+DAG or 1-hop analysis-directed brief), 4 execution routing intents, risk-based ambiguity triage, OKLCH 60-30-10 + @theme inline shadows, Phase 0 Scope Lock, and <=5-rule disjoint DAG

Stage 2 (ui-worker): Materialize DESIGN.md and build clean Light/Dark UI with 3-layer shadows, dark zenithal rim lighting, matte glass, @container/subgrid, silent CSS breadcrumbs, GPU .skip-link, real FSM, zero secrets/omissions, and RAW SHA-256 + tsc

Stage 3 (ui-judge): Run Double-Pass (Macro + Micro) 3-Axis Judge (ui_code, execution_plan, technical_audit) with deterministic P0..P3 tiers, WCAG 2.2 OKLab contrast (FNR < 0.001), 4-Pillar >= 90, 6-Dim >= 85, and Self-Refine max_self_refine_rounds=3 before HITL
